market.question: When will Bitcoin cross $100k again?
market.description:
This market will settle to Yes if the price of Bitcoin is above $100,000.00 at any point after the creation of this market and before 12:00 AM ET on November 1, 2026.

Outcome sourced from CF Benchmarks' Bitcoin Real-Time Index.

The market settles based on the CF Bitcoin Real-Time Index (BRTI) using a trimmed mean calculation over any sixty second period, excluding the top 20% and bottom 20% of values. If this trimmed mean crosses the threshold at any point, the market settles to Yes. Otherwise, the market settles to No.
market.title: Before November 2026
